posts.description: Intro Here in Seattle we are blessed with an abundance of Cyclocross racing! I’ve been to races put on by four different organizations this season, and they’ve all been great. posts.title: Getting Fit Again
posts.description: Humbled on the Racquetball Court In April ’24, a friend’s father invited a few of us to his gym to play racquetball. He also let us invade his house for a few days for a solar eclipse – he’s a real nice guy. Anyway, the main point is: this man is around 70 years old, and he crushed me .
